name: Payment and Receipt Voucher Maker
title: Payment and Receipt Voucher Maker Pakistan (Free, PDF)
description: Make a payment voucher or receipt voucher with account head, amount in words, mode and approval boxes. Free, prints to PDF, nothing is uploaded.
lead: Choose payment or receipt, add the account head and amount, and print a voucher with signature boxes.
intro: A voucher is the internal document behind an entry in your books. A payment voucher supports money going out. A receipt voucher supports money coming in. Both carry the account head, amount, mode and the people who prepared, checked and approved it.
how: Enter the party, account head, amount, mode and narration (what it is for).
Print and collect signatures. Attach the bill or receipt behind it.
example: Payment voucher PV-0007: Rs. 15,000 paid by cheque to a supplier for office supplies, account head "Office expenses".
mistakes: No narration, so nobody remembers what it was for later.

faq.a: The ledger account the amount is booked to, such as Rent, Salaries or Sales.

faq.q: Do I need vouchers if I use accounting software?
faq.a: Many businesses still keep them as supporting documents for audit.
Yes. Keep one running series for each voucher type.

disclaimer: This tool only lays out the details you type. It does not file anything with FBR or any authority, and it is not legal or tax advice.
